Wait For Identity.description: Gives ISC time to create the identity cube from the new source account before processing it.

Find Created Identity.description: Resolves the identity created from the new account so a single identity refresh can run.

Check Identity Created.description: Skips identity processing when the new account has not yet produced an identity cube.

Refresh Created Identity.description: Runs a single identity refresh for the new hire so attributes, roles, and manager correlation evaluate immediately.

attributes.message:
Thank you. A record has been created for your new hire. The sign-in name is the generated name, or the first free numeric suffix when that name is already taken. Access and applications will be assigned according to your organisation's standard process.

Name {{$.setConfiguration.displayName}}
Email {{$.collectDetails.formData.email}}
Sign-in name {{$.findCreatedIdentity.identities[0].attributes.uid}}
Location {{$.collectDetails.formData.location}}
Manager {{$.collectDetails.formData.manager}}

Please allow a short time for the new record to appear across all systems.
attributes.title: Onboarding request submitted

attributes.message: The request for {{$.setConfiguration.displayName}} has been sent to {{$.getManager.identities[0].attributes.displayName}} for approval. Keep this window open, or return when you are notified of the decision.
attributes.title: Waiting for manager approval

attributes.message:
The manager declined this onboarding request. No directory record was created.

Name {{$.setConfiguration.displayName}}
Manager {{$.getManager.identities[0].attributes.displayName}}
Comments {{$.managerApproval.formData.approvalComments}}
attributes.title: Onboarding declined

Check Manager Approval Required.description: Check the Set configuration variable Manager Approval Required. true sends the standalone approval form to the selected manager; any other value creates the account immediately.

Get Matched Account.description: Loads the selected identity's account on the configured source for the before-and-after preview.

attributes.message: Confirm update — Review the selected account before applying any changes.
attributes.title: Confirm account update

Update Matched Account.description: Updates the selected flat-file account. The existing id and name are sent again so the sign-in name stays unchanged.

Refresh Updated Identity.description: Refreshes the selected identity after its source account changes.

attributes.message:
